page.content:
Spider-Man 2 is a licensed sub-theme of Spider-Man released in 2004, and reintroduced as a subtheme of Marvel Super Heroes in 2025. The sets are based on the movie of the same name.

page.overview:
What is Spider-Man 2?

Spider-Man 2 is a licensed sub-theme of Spider-Man released in 2004, and reintroduced as a subtheme of Marvel Super Heroes in 2025. The sets are based on the movie of the same name.
